# Page 1^page=1
I exported a Web of Science topic search for "block copolymer phase behavior" restricted to 2022 (the paper's exact query and year), as BibT eX with the Full Record option so abstracts are included. The search returned 307 documents (the paper reported 305; a two-paper drift is expected because W eb of Science re-indexes over time). For this understanding-focused run I took the first 50 abstracts as the working subset, all of which have abstracts and parse cleanly. I then manually labelled all 50 against the paper's Step 2 inclusion rule: positive only if the abstract reports the phase behaviour of a single, linear block copolymer in bulk/melt/molten state; anything in solvent/water/salt/ionic-liquid, thin-film or surface- only, nanoparticle/composite, blend-only, or non-linear (star, bottlebrush, graft, miktoarm) is negative. That gave 5 positives and 45 negatives. The low positive rate is expected - the 2022 query pulls in mostly aqueous self- assembly, drug-delivery, blend, and device papers - and it mirrors the paper's own funnel (218/305 unanimously negative). Note that this manual labelling was done by myself with minimal knowledge, rather than a subject matter expert, too.
